sentences.en: When the war ended, he had to go into exile.
sentences.zh: 战争结束后，他不得不流放。

sentences.en: No one shall be subjected to arbitrary arrest, detention or exile.
sentences.zh: 任何人不得遭受任意逮捕、拘留或流放。

sentences.en: Napoleon lived in exile on the island of Elba.
sentences.zh: 拿破仑被流放到厄尔巴岛生活。

senses.zh: 流放, 放逐, 使流亡
